Hi Elena / Samir / Priya — great to connect today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned on decision signals and milestones. I captured a first-pass MAP and an evidence checklist (attached).

Call highlights (short):
- Economic buyer: Samir (confirmed) — primary approval for license and budget.
- Security/legal gate: Priya (InfoSec) + external counsel loop for standard DPAs / share redlines.
- Procurement: Elena managing PO and vendor intake; timeline constrained by quarterly close (end of May).
- Decision signals we heard: 1) cost-per-transaction estimate, 2) deterministic latency under 150ms for core flows, 3) acceptable data residency & audit logging.

Proposed MAP (high level, attached PDF has tasks):
- Week 1 (this week): Share MAP + security evidence index (attached). Redwood to provide SOC 2 excerpts, KMS integration notes, and a short demo playback for the payments flow.
- Week 2: Technical deep-dive with Priya and engineering (30–45m) to validate latency and logging.
- Week 3: Legal + procurement review DPA + SOW; we’ll incorporate any redlines and provide a target SOW draft.
- Week 4: Executive approval and PO issuance (target end-of-May to align with your quarter close).

Asks for your team:
1) Can Priya confirm availability for a technical session next Tue/Wed?
2) Elena — what is the procurement intake form we should complete (or a link to the portal)?
3) Samir — any internal finance checklist we should be aware of for the approval path?

Attachments: LumenPay_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan); security-evidence-index.xlsx (stub table of SOC/controls).

I’ll send the MAP to our engineering partner (Jordan) and Marissa to coordinate internal resources. If you want any changes to the MAP before the technical session, flag them and I’ll iterate.

Thanks,
Rishi
